_comment: SCRATCH LOOK-TEST SCENE. A flat plane and one of each baked tree variant, built to answer one question that thumbnails cannot: does the canopy read dense under real lighting. It is NOT a biome recipe and declares no lighting of its own -- apply_lighting.py is run against recipes/alpine_8k.json so the R13 block stays declared in exactly one place (NN24). Delete the level freely; nothing references it.

ground._note: Plane is 100x100 cm, so scale 300 gives a 300 m square.

scratch._spacing_note: Widest tree measured 8.55 m (Baltic_Pine_01_A), so 14 m keeps crowns clear of each other and lets each silhouette be judged alone.
scratch._trees_note: All four Norway Spruce variants as exported from PVE as Static Meshes. The single-variable armature-bake comparison is committed at c1a55341, frame _verify/20260815_pve_export_vs_armature_bake.png.
